policy: Nine credible publishing organizations were screened. Primary sources were read substantively; selection prioritizes current evidence while using justified extended fallback only within 168 hours.

source_candidates.title: Designing failover across OpenAI model providers
verified_facts: OpenAI’s production-routing guide separates multi-provider availability from safe workflow recovery.
Start with one read-only inference step.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 132-hour primary engineering guide is the freshest verified source found that supplies an end-to-end, testable provider-failover policy and remains within the allowed 168-hour extended fallback.

source_candidates.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
verified_facts: IBM Granite’s 8B and 30B Switch 4.1 checkpoints combine a general decision adapter, a guardian adapter and a speech encoder with the base chat model.
Evaluate the composed checkpoint as a system: verify adapter routing, classification quality, speech accuracy, cache behavior, memory use and latency on your own traffic.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 108-hour release remains within the permitted 168-hour window and is the freshest verified primary technical source found on composable decision, safety and speech adapters in one checkpoint.

source_candidates.title: Why your platform team shouldn’t build an AI context layer (even though they probably could)
verified_facts: Stack Overflow divides an enterprise AI context layer into capture, validation, organization, governance and delivery.
Inventory one knowledge workflow across all five stages before funding a platform.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 108-hour source is the freshest verified primary product analysis found that decomposes operational knowledge governance into concrete lifecycle responsibilities, within the 168-hour limit.

source_candidates.title: Our approach to working with AI companies
verified_facts: METR explains how external AI-risk work can inform the public without pretending to certify deployment decisions.
When reading an AI safety assessment, check who paid, what evaluators could access, which evidence was removed, how methods can be challenged and whether conclusions exceed the scope.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 132-hour source is the freshest verified primary statement found that makes independence, redactions and assessment limitations explicit for public AI-risk evidence, within the 168-hour limit.

source_candidates.title: Context Engineering: How Deep Agents Remember
verified_facts: LangChain describes five Deep Agents mechanisms for limiting context rot: offload large inputs to files, summarize older turns, load skills only when relevant, isolate noisy work in subagents and persist selected knowledge as plain Markdown.
Keep active context small without deleting evidence.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 132-hour source is the freshest verified primary guide found that explains five recoverable context-management mechanisms together, and it remains within the permitted 168-hour fallback.

source_candidates.title: Agent Skills
verified_facts: OpenCode documents portable SKILL.md discovery across project, global, Claude-compatible and agent-compatible paths.
Create a read-only release skill, test its name and discovery, deny unrelated internal skills and require approval before any publishing command.
